name: Content Calendar (Google Sheets) → AI Copy → CEKIVA (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Threads, Bluesky)

parameters.content:
## Content calendar (Google Sheets) → AI copy → CEKIVA

Every hour the workflow reads the rows of your calendar whose **Status is READY**, has Gemini write a post for each network, and CEKIVA publishes (or schedules) them. The row is updated with the outcome. No Merge nodes, no expiring Graph API tokens: one CEKIVA request per network. X (Twitter) is not included: CEKIVA retired that channel.

**1 · Credentials (3)**
• `Google Sheets` — your Google account (OAuth2). Select it in **Get READY rows**, **Lock row**, **Write result**, and point those three nodes at your calendar (`REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_SHEET_ID`; the first tab).
• `Gemini API key` — Header Auth: header `x-goog-api-key`. Select it in **Gemini: write the copy**.
• `CEKIVA API key` — Header Auth: header `Authorization`, value `Bearer tplk_...`. Select it in **CEKIVA: POST /v1/posts**.

**2 · The calendar** — first row = these headers: Status, Topic, Brief, Link, Image URL, Publish At, Client ID, Platforms, Result, Post IDs, Updated. Set Status to READY when a row should go out. Details in the README.

**3 · Safety** — a row is set to PROCESSING before anything is sent, so it can never be sent twice; at most 3 rows per run (see **Validate rows**). Posting costs CEKIVA credits (prices are shown in CEKIVA).
